limitations: Browser/origin-local IndexedDB; no server, sync, encryption or authenticated authorization.
Current profile read argument is an interface-level gate, not protection against same-origin script tampering.
Existing backup/reset excludes new archive and policy.
Existing S1 technical singleton snapshot and legacy S2 cognitive completion logs remain governed by their old behavior.
No old-data migration, owner guessing, clinical validation or new metrics.
Unfinished runtime does not resume after reload; successful saved rows survive reload and their UUID keys prevent overwrite/duplicate retries.
Deleted owners are not reassigned; archive retention is unchanged.
